summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K announcing the beginning of a succession process for its CEO, Ivan de Souza Monteiro, whose term ends April 30, 2027. The Board approved temporary creation of an Executive Vice Presidency held by Elio Wolff from June 1, 2026, until the CEO transition, and dissolved the Strategy and Business Development Vice Presidency. The structured transition includes reporting changes and support from a specialized consulting firm. This is a planned, orderly succession, not a forced departure. The company reaffirms commitment to governance and capital discipline. Watch for CEO candidate announcements and any strategic shifts.
